headline: Weak and short-period with onshore by midday — nothing here today.
today: Just 1.1-1.2ft at short period from a fair S angle, and the SSW goes onshore by afternoon. Light morning glass is the only redeeming feature and it's barely surfable. Skip the 3hr haul.

daysToWatch.note: 1.8-2.1ft good angle with N offshore dawn and morning — cleanest Matunuck window of the week. If you're driving, this is the morning.
Biggest at 2.6-3.1ft good angle but SSW onshore all day keeps it messy. Size is there, shape isn't.
